title: Gradient Manipulation in Distributed Stochastic Gradient Descent with Strategic Agents: Truthful Incentives with Convergence Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2603.27962v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distributed learning has gained significant attention due to its advantages in scalability, privacy, and fault tolerance.In this paradigm, multiple agents collaboratively train a global model by exchanging parameters only with their neighbors. However, a key vulnerability of existing distributed learning approaches is their implicit assumption that all agents behave honestly during gradient updates. In real-world scenarios, this assumption often breaks down, as selfish or strategic agents may be incentivized to manipulate gradients for personal gain, ultimately compromising the final learning outcome. In this work, we propose a fully distributed payment mechanism that, for the first time, guarantees both truthful behaviors and accurate convergence in distributed stochastic gradient descent. This represents a significant advancement, as it overcomes two major limitations of existing truthfulness mechanisms for collaborative learning:(

translated_abstract: 分布式学习因其在可扩展性、隐私保护和容错方面的优势而受到广泛关注。在这种范式下，多个智能体仅通过与邻居交换参数来协同训练一个全局模型。然而，现有分布式学习方法的一个关键弱点在于其隐含假设所有智能体在梯度更新过程中都表现诚实。在现实场景中，这一假设往往不成立，因为自私或策略性的智能体可能出于个人利益的动机操纵梯度，最终损害最终的学习效果。在本工作中，我们提出了一种完全分布式的支付机制，首次在分布式随机梯度下降中同时保证了真实行为和精确收敛。这是一项重大进展，因为它克服了现有协作学习真实性机制的两个主要局限：（
tldr: 首次提出一种完全分布式的支付机制，在存在策略性智能体可能操纵梯度的分布式随机梯度下降中，同时保证智能体的真实行为与模型训练的精确收敛。
en_tdlr: A fully distributed payment mechanism is proposed that, for the first time, guarantees both truthful agent behavior and accurate convergence in distributed stochastic gradient descent in the presence of strategic gradient manipulation.
